title: The Washing of Regeneration
definition: The Washing of Regeneration is the cleansing work of God by the Holy Spirit through which sinners are renewed in salvation.
summary: The Washing of Regeneration points to the cleansing and renewing work of the Spirit in salvation.
christFocus: Jesus Christ pours out the Spirit and grants cleansing to those saved by mercy.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine emphasizes that salvation involves inward cleansing, not outward religious polish. The Spirit washes, renews, and gives life through the mercy of God in Christ. It reminds believers that the deepest stain of sin cannot be removed by self-reform.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because people often try to cleanse themselves through denial, ritual, or moral effort. Regeneration announces that God Himself must make the sinner clean and new. It gives hope to those who feel spiritually filthy and beyond repair.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask the Lord to make His cleansing work visible in your desires and habits. Do not return to shame when Christ has washed you. Present the Gospel as mercy that cleanses from the inside out.
